name: Axis Matrix
description: Playable Coltrane tonal center navigator - fader position, clock trigger

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — center position: three zones with snap; approach chords sound in the transition zones at boundaries
Alt (Shift) — harmonic function: bottom = root (Maj7), middle = dominant (Dom7), top = subdominant approach (m7)
Third (Btn hold) — Feel: swing and velocity dynamics, bottom = straight and flat

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Short tap — mute (silences held chords, parks CV at 0 V)
Hold — toggle drone mode (sustain indefinitely, immediate fader response)
Shift + tap — toggle latch (chord holds until tapped again)
Shift + hold — cycle Interval: minor 3rd, major 3rd, 4th, tritone

sections.heading: Sustain
items: Clock-gated — each chord holds until the next one
Legato — same, and the last chord keeps ringing when the clock stops
Staccato — every note releases halfway through its own step

sections.heading: Signal / LEDs
items: Three tonal center hues rotated around the app colour — brightness dims as fader drifts from center
CV Out tracks root pitch of current position
CV In Position modulates center selection; CV In Function modulates harmonic function
Button blinks when latched, stays bright when droning, ducks on chord trigger
Interval flashes one colour per step

channels.jackDescription: CV Out sends the root pitch of the current matrix position and parks at 0 V while muted. CV In Position modulates the center selection; CV In Function modulates the harmonic function.
channels.faderDescription: Selects one of three tonal centers with snap zones. Transition zones at boundaries sound approach chords.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Harmonic function at the current center: root (Maj7), dominant (Dom7) or subdominant approach (m7).
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Humanises the playing: swings the off-beats and shapes velocity, accenting the root chord while approach chords lighten. Bottom is straight and flat.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes and unmutes, cutting any held chord. Hold toggles drone mode: the chord sustains indefinitely and updates on fader movement, ignoring the clock.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + tap toggles latch: the chord sustains until tapped again regardless of fader movement. Shift + hold cycles the Interval between minor 3rd, major 3rd, 4th and tritone.
channels.ledTop: Center hue with brightness gradient (dims away from center)
